## Non-negotiable boundaries

- CLI only: Claude Desktop / Cowork cannot run this skill.
- GitHub, SSH, and remote WP-CLI must all verify before onboarding is complete.
- Local-first is the default. Direct production edits are elevated, explicitly
  approved, logged as `[DIRECT-PROD]`, and mirrored back to Git immediately.
- No secret belongs in this file, `.claude/`, Git, a command argument, or chat.
- The scan proves connectivity and visible architecture; it does not prove that a
  host backup exists or that an untested production write is safe.
